1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of __greater than__ 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a __monovalent or divalent__ cation crosslinker.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __one of a group consisting of__ polyethylenimine, polypropylenimine, or __polyamidoamine__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), polystyrene sulfonate, copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, or __other suitable anionic polyelectrolytes__.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex __nanoparticle has an average particle size in the range of about__ 100 to ___800___ nm in diameter.

9) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in __aqueous solutions, brine solutions, and sewage water.__

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than **___one__** micron, with a defined weight ratio of polyanion to polycation.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping __at least one__ multivalent cation.

14) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle for delivery of an oil and gas chemical to a reservoir, said composition comprising a polyethylenimine of __a molecular weight__ less than 2000 Da and a polyanion intimately associated with an oil and gas field chemical to form a polyelectrolyte complex, said complex having an average particle size of less than one micron and __a controlled charge ratio__.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __that can crosslink comprising____ gelatin or an acrylate-based polymer___; and c) a fluid.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylic acid and acrylamide, __poly(ethylene glycol), or any other suitable polymer.__
